1000 GRID · CREATIVITY · IMAGINE BEYOND THE EXISTING
Creativity is the first value of the currency: the ability to see what does not exist yet and make it real.
The 1000 note states one rule, turn 45° and grow by √2, and repeats it until the form leaves the page.
The grid is not a limit on the idea. It is the ground the idea departs from.
Six squares share one corner; each is turned 45° and grown by √2.
Every far corner lies on r = u√2·e^0.44φ: a curve from straight edges.
K6 to K10 keep growing and break the frame. The idea exceeds the page.
Rotated ellipses and trochoids ring a window holding the outlined mark.
The numerals turn from ink to paper as they leave the type column.
Origin O on a grid vertex.
FLAT-COLOUR SEPARATION · ONE PLATE PER ROLE

Seven flat fills, no gradients, no transparency, no effects. Every overprint is an
explicit colour layer; every pattern uses a colour from this palette only.
SECTION E · P01 – P08 · HIGHLIGHT = IN USE
SECTION B · L01 – L08 · NAMED GROUPS
Border, keylines, ruler band, corner details
Colour blocks and the large geometric composition
Guilloché, contour, hatching, micro-grids, dot systems

Denomination, GRID, title, phrase, serials, microcopy
Thread, tactile code, latent image, registration, micro-elements
